method: Hourly samples; Sun is up when Sun alt > local horizon at the Sun azimuth (isAboveHorizon, same rule as the POWER verdict), CR1 profile from app/src/data/horizons.json (real LOLA DEM, 2 m eye height, range 9990 m). Ephemeris: app/src/lib/ephemeris.js (astronomy-engine + IAU lunar rotation model).

published.note: Accumulated illumination at 2 m above ground, spot 1 (89.4395°S, 222.8066°E). Different window and method from the computed number — a check, not an equality claim.
